title: Default's page lists Default rules with no checkboxes and no Set Rule
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, whose Default is 40% markup in every range.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click Default's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Default is row 1.

Step 2:

  • Default's Pricing tab lists every matrix, matrix A among them, with its Default rule: matrix A reads 40% markup.
  • The list has no checkboxes and no Set Rule bar, while every matrix is listed.
